steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and deseed 300 g of melon, then purée the flesh using a blender until smooth.
Combine the chia seeds with the coconut milk in a small bowl; let stand 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix the cooked quinoa, melon purée, and chia seed mixture together.
Add the cinnamon and coconut oil to the bowl and stir until fully combined.
Scoop rounded tablespoons of the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them 3 cm apart.
Flatten each portion gently with the back of a spoon to form small round bites.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the edges are set and lightly golden.
Cool on the baking sheet for 10 minutes before serving; the bites firm up as they cool.
Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.
